name: Summation energy meter
summary: Integrating device that adds energy from several meters or circuits to give one total register.
description: A summation meter totalises energy from more than one circuit. It may count pulses from several transmitting meters or, in older schemes, be fed by a summation CT, and it appears where several incomers or feeders must be billed or monitored as one supply.

Every input must use the same direction convention and consistent pulse weights, or the total is wrong. The symbol shows the summing function but not the inputs, so each source meter should be listed with its weighting.
readingNotes: List every meter or circuit that feeds the total.
Check pulse weights and directions are consistent.
distinction: A summation meter totals several circuits; a summation CT adds currents before measurement.
